source_kind: Official CSIRO ZIP central-directory metadata, fetched with bounded HTTP Range requests

archive.etag_interpretation: Opaque multipart ETag ending -263; not the archive MD5/SHA256. No Content-MD5 or custom MD5/SHA256 header was provided.

version_identity.note: Official v1/v2 /data list the same file ID 58895460, filename, byte length and lastUpdated; v2 metadata is not evidence of replacement/corrected MRI payloads.

coverage.note: All 422 non-directory entries are .nii.gz LFOV images or semantic labels; no SFOV, registration transforms, CSV/JSON case-specific sequence table or README is listed inside this archive.

identity_limits: Each entry CRC32 is for the ZIP-uncompressed file payload, i.e. the .nii.gz bytes, not decoded NIfTI voxel arrays. CRC32 is not a cryptographic identity proof.
Mapping official Case_015 to course M015 (and other numeric suffixes/visits) is only a candidate until content is checked. Names, numeric IDs and matching counts alone do not prove identity.
A mismatch in .nii.gz byte count/CRC32 does not establish a voxel error: gzip metadata, NIfTI headers or anonymization may differ. Decoded-array/geometry comparison would then be required.
No MRI, label voxel payload, temporary presigned URL, credentials or connection metadata is saved in this catalog.

The official intended acquisition is LFOV T2 SPACE according to the primary paper; this file list provides no per-case TR/TE/SeriesDescription. Dark bladder appearance alone does not establish T1 contamination or M015 failure causality.
